name: NON AC ROOM
description:
A Non-AC room is a budget-friendly hotel or guest accommodation that relies on natural airflow, ceiling fans, or desk fans instead of mechanical air conditioning.

Key Features & Amenities

• Cooling: Equipped with a high-speed ceiling fan, wall fan, or standing desk fan rather than an AC unit.
• Ventilation: Designed with large windows, exhaust vents, or balconies to promote natural air circulation and daylight.
• Bed & Furniture: Includes a single, double, queen, or king-size bed with clean linens and pillows, accompanied by a wardrobe, cupboard, or clothes rack.
• Work & Seating Area: Often comes with a small writing desk, chair, or a compact side table with seating.
• Bathroom: Features a private attached bathroom with a shower, basic toiletries, and regular or 24-hour hot/cold water supply.
• Electronics & Connectivity: Standard inclusions often feature free Wi-Fi, a television (LED or flat-screen), and an intercom, though some basic properties omit the TV.
• Value: Generally offers a more economical per-night tariff compared to air-conditioned rooms.
